## Summary

Describe the problem, the user-facing change, and any relevant issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant browser/service regressions
- [ ] Desktop and mobile screenshots for visual changes

List any checks not run and why.

## Safety and documentation

- [ ] Regression coverage added or the testing gap explained
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior or setup changed
- [ ] Upload, consent, retention, and failure handling preserved
- [ ] No private documents, tester records, credentials, or trading data included
- [ ] License and repository ownership boundaries preserved
